description: Search for international directives, regulations, and conventions that have been implemented or referenced by Ghanaian statutes. Search by keyword (e.g., "data protection", "cybersecurity"), filter by type (directive/regulation), or year range. Returns international documents with counts of Ghanaian statutes referencing them.

has_ghanaian_implementation.description: If true, only return documents that have at least one Ghanaian implementing statute

query.description: Keyword search across international document titles and short names (e.g., "data protection")

year_from.description: Filter: documents from this year onwards

year_to.description: Filter: documents up to this year

name: search_eu_implementations
